messages.content: You are a highly efficient assistant, who evaluates and selects the best large language model (LLMs) based on the quality of their responses to a given instruction. This process will be used to create a leaderboard reflecting the most accurate and human-preferred answers.

I require a leaderboard for various large language models. I'll provide you with prompts given to these models and their corresponding outputs. Your task is to assess these responses, and select the model that produces the best output from a human perspective.

## Instruction

{
    "instruction": """Draft an apology email to a customer who experienced a delay in their order, and provide reassurance that the issue has been resolved.""",
}

## Model Outputs

Here are the unordered outputs from the models. Each output is associated with a specific model, identified by a unique model identifier.

{
    {
        "model_identifier": "m",
        "output": """Subject: Apologies for the Delay in Your Order

Dear [Customer's Name],

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to sincerely apologize for the delay in the delivery of your recent order. We understand how important it is for you to receive your items promptly, and we regret any inconvenience this may have caused.

We want to assure you that we have taken immediate steps to address the issue and prevent any future delays. Our team has conducted a thorough investigation and has implemented measures to ensure that our fulfillment processes are more efficient. We have also re-evaluated our inventory management to avoid similar incidents in the future.

We are committed to making things right and have expedited the processing of your order. Your package is currently on its way to you and should arrive within the next few days. In the meantime, if you have any questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to reach out to our customer support team. We are here to assist you and ensure your satisfaction.

Once again, we apologize for the delay and appreciate your understanding and patience. We value your business and look forward to serving you in the future.

Warm regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Position]
[Your Company]
[Contact Information]"""
    },
    {
        "model_identifier": "M",
        "output": """Subject: Our Sincere Apologies for the Delay in Your Order

Dear [Customer Name],

I hope this message finds you well.

Firstly, I want to extend my sincerest apologies for the unexpected delay in the delivery of your order [Order Number]. At [Your Company Name], we pride ourselves on our commitment to customer satisfaction and timely service, and we recognize that we have fallen short in this instance.

The delay was due to [brief explanation of the reason for the delay, e.g., supply chain disruptions, unexpected demand, technical issues]. We understand that this has likely caused you inconvenience, and we are genuinely sorry for any trouble this has caused you.

Please rest assured that we have taken the necessary steps to address the issue. [Provide details on what you’ve done to resolve the problem and prevent future occurrences, e.g., we have streamlined our processing system, increased our inventory, expanded our team, etc.].

As a gesture of our commitment to you and to express our regret, we would like to offer you [mention any compensation, if applicable, such as a discount, free shipping on your next order, etc.]. To redeem this, simply [instructions on how to use the compensation].

We are pleased to inform you that your order is now on its way and is scheduled to arrive on [revised delivery date]. You can track the status of your shipment using the following tracking number: [Tracking Number].

We value your patience and understanding in this matter and would like to assure you that we are dedicated to providing you with the high-quality service that you expect and deserve. Should you have any further concerns or require assistance, please do not hesitate to contact our customer service team at [contact information].

Thank you for your continued support. We look forward to serving you better in the future.

Warm regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Position]
[Your Company Name]
[Contact Information]"""
    }
}

## Task

Evaluate the models based on the quality and relevance of their outputs, and select the model that generated the best output. Answer by providing the model identifier of the best model. We will use your output as the name of the best model, so make sure your output only contains one of the following model identifiers and nothing else (no quotes, no spaces, no new lines, ...): m or M.
